licence: restricted: per-file header line 5 says MIT for code; root LICENSE lines 5-9 forbid use of code or resources without authorization and ban commercial use; lines 13-17 add community agreements for some folders
best_idea: Keep one platform default table for phones and desktop, apply the whole graphics record in one fixed order at boot and on change, and store it as typed data that falls back per field.
decision_why: The phone default set (frame cap 60, shadows off, AA off, vsync off) is the frame budget row 16 needs; take the table and the single apply path, drop reflection-based prefs and the dead toggles, and fix the enum save defect (licence is restricted, so clean-room only).
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, a 30-second fight holds the 60 fps cap with shadows and anti-aliasing off (frame times in the devtools performance panel); a test where the save throws leaves the new tier applied and the old saved record intact; a corrupt saved record loads the phone default without throwing.
